{{Quote|The Empire is relying more and more on their Elite Novatrooper Commanders. By breaking the chain of command at that level we can disrupt their operations greatly.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:OWL" />}}
'''Operation Weakest Link''' was one of the last small operations that were led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] against the increasing activity of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="SWG:OWL" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] struggled for the control of several cities in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During periods of Rebel occupation of the cities of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] or [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Luke Skywalker landed in these three cities aboard his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Narrow Margin]]''. Accompanied by a group of Rebel [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], the young man attempted to rally support for the Alliance cause and recruit troops for dangerous missions against the Empire. Skywalker recruited a group of skillful spacers affiliated with the Alliance to hunt down military forces of the Empire. The spacers subsequently infiltrated an Imperial [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]] in deep space where they assassinated an elite [[Novatrooper]] Commander of the Empire.<ref name="SWG:OWL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation Weakest Link appeared as a quest in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OWL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The quest was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref>

During periods of Rebel [[W:c:swg:Galactic Civil War#Planetary control game|occupation]] of the cities of Anchorhead, Coronet or Theed, Luke Skywalker would periodically land in these cities. Skywalker would offer players of the Rebel [[W:c:swg:Faction|faction]] up to eight different [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]], half of which were designated as "[[W:c:swg:Galactic Civil War#Combatant|Combatant]]" quests (to be carried out against Imperial non-player characters), and the other half of which were designated as "[[W:c:swg:Galactic Civil War#Special Forces|Special Forces]]" quests (to be carried out against Imperial-aligned players). Operation Weakest Link was the fourth of the four Rebel Combatant missions that players received from Luke Skywalker.<ref name="SWG:OWL" />
